name: Cabedelo
note: Beach break against the south jetty of the Mondego mouth, lefts and rights, very consistent, holds 3 m+. Crowded, strong rips. All levels.
cam_shows: Praia do Cabedelo, jetty and peak

name: São Pedro de Moel
note: Small beach between rocky points, sand with rock, barrels, rarely crowded. Rocks and some localism.
cam_shows: Praia de São Pedro de Moel

name: Nazaré – Praia do Norte
note: Expert, big-wave only. Canyon-focused, very powerful from 2 m, holds 5 m+. Strong rips, rocks at the north end. Not a spot for a normal session.
cam_shows: Praia do Norte from the lighthouse fort, canyon peak

name: Nazaré – Praia da Vila
note: Town beach south of the Sítio headland, sheltered from N wind. Very fast heavy shorebreak, one of the heaviest waves in Portugal. Experienced surfers.

name: Baleal Norte
note: North side of the Baleal causeway, picks up N/NW swell, fun learner and intermediate wave, surf schools in summer. All levels.
cam_shows: Baleal panoramic; which side of the causeway is not stated

name: Lagide
note: Left-hand flat reef with a right peak, mushy small then fast above 2 m. Urchins, rocks, competitive crowd. Intermediate and up.

name: Cantinho da Baía (Baleal Sul)
note: South-facing bay inside Baleal, the softest wave in Peniche and the surf-school beach. Sheltered from N wind; holds when the exposed beaches are blown out. Very crowded, rips on bigger days.

name: Molhe Leste
note: Right-hand sandbar wedge off the harbour breakwater, hollow, fast, short. Heavy localism. Experienced only.

name: Supertubos
note: Heavy sand-bottom barrels left and right, WSL venue, holds 3 m+. Crowded, many bodyboarders, usually small in summer. Advanced only.
cam_shows: Supertubos peak with live wave, wind and tide readout

name: Consolação
note: Right point over flat rock on the south side of the headland, plus a sand beach on the north side. Needs 1.5 m+ to start, holds 5 m. Rocks, urchins. Experienced.
cam_shows: Praia da Consolação, north beach side

name: Areia Branca
note: River-mouth beach break, lefts and rights, high frequency, all levels. Headland shelters from N wind. Urchins and rocks near the point.

name: Santa Cruz – Praia da Física
note: Powerful open beach break, regional classic, closes out above 2 m. Crowded when on. Praia do Navio and Praia Azul are the same stretch.
cam_shows: Santa Cruz, Praia do Navio, the next beach north (0.8 km)
